narrative: The yard, left of the stage, a timber post to lean on. A fair house, not a great one. Henslowe at the stair-foot, eyes on the boxes. On the boards, under the gilt throne hung in the heavens in June, Alleyn in gilded mail. Drums, a pageant, blows given and taken from outside.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid a penny and stood left of the stage.
